notes: Single panel. Sheet is drawn north-up but rotated very slightly (E-W centrelines rise ~30-35 px from west to east; Young's centre drifts from x~1205 at Ringgold to ~1255 at Liberty); scale ~3.47 px per ft. West edge: the paper ends at x~209, so Cumber (east line x~266, 40 ft, centre ~197) is off the paper and Cumber/Milton, Cumber/Liberty and Cumber/Corporation Alley are not recorded (sheet 157 has the first two); Josephine/Ringgold (157) is also off this paper. West of Young the blocks are the 157 blocks east of Drake: Pueblo there is 40 ft ('PUEBLO', same street as 157's east leg) and ends at Young; east of Young it continues as 'PUEBLO ALLEY' (20'), centred ~30 px further south, so two T points on Young. Young is 50' north of Pueblo (continues north across Ringgold between the 164/165 outlines, so Young/Ringgold is a cross) and 40' from Pueblo to Liberty; between Pueblo and Boal it is printed 'YOUNG (IMPASSABLE)' but still drawn as a 40 ft street; south of Liberty the 154 outline has no opening, so Young/Liberty is T. Slack (40') runs Young to Highland. 'TORBET ALLEY' (20') runs Slack to Pueblo Alley only. A 16 ft unnamed 'ALLEY' runs Ringgold to Slack at x~3470-3481, in line with a gap in the 165 outlines north of Ringgold (unnamed; key map shows nothing there), and continues south of Slack as 'ELIJAH AL.' (16', narrowing to ~11-14 ft south of Pueblo Alley) to Boal, so Elijah/Slack is marked cross; Pueblo Alley ends at Elijah. Boal is printed 'BOAL' (40'). Milton 50'. 'CORPORATION ALLEY' (also printed 'CORPORATON', 20') runs from Cumber (off paper) across Young, Ludlow and Hiram to Highland. An unnamed 20 ft 'ALLEY' runs Milton to Corporation Alley in line with 'LUDLOW' (20'), which runs Corporation Alley to Liberty. 'HIRAM' (20') runs Milton to Liberty. Pendleton is only a 153/154 outline south of Liberty (60 ft, angled SSE); its T point is where its pipe/centreline (x~661 at y 4198, slope ~0.29) meets the Liberty centreline. Liberty: north line ~4021 (west) to ~3977 (Highland), south line is the 154/153 outline (steps ~40 px south at Pendleton); printed 38' at Cumber and 50' at Highland. Highland Avenue (printed 'HIGHLAND AV.', 48' printed near Liberty) is the east edge: only its west line is drawn (x~3815 at Ringgold, ~3828 at Slack, ~3797 at Boal, ~3750-3762 at Milton, ~3750 at Corporation and Liberty); its east line is beyond the paper edge (x~3922-3932). All Highland points are therefore the west line + 83 px (24 ft) -- uncertain by ~15 px, and the Ringgold (3898) and Slack (3911) points lie only ~10-25 px inside the paper edge. No street continues east of Highland on the key map (sheet 159 block), so all Highland junctions are T.
